# Point.share MDai

- Use Node.js, Express, EJS, MongoDB/Mongoose, and Socket.IO.
- Keep the private platform focused on administrator-managed users and shared resources.
- Follow MVC-style organization under `src/`.
- Preserve role checks, password hashing, upload validation, and first-login password changes.
- Keep the interface professional, restrained, responsive, and accessible.
- Validate changes with focused syntax or lint checks before documentation updates.
